tools.name: Semantic Graph

tools.name: Reactive Impact Frontier
tools.description: Propagate a bounded source change through dependent files and contained symbols without executing or mutating code.

tools.name: Deterministic Validation Micro-space

tools.name: Deterministic Variant Tournament
tools.description: Rank passing repeatable shard evidence by measured latency while refusing automatic merge or deletion.

tools.name: Unanimous Quorum Court
tools.description: Bind proposer, skeptic, and judge votes from three independent contexts to one candidate, graph, checkpoint, and proof set.

tools.name: Immune Quarantine
tools.description: Isolate evidence disagreement, digest drift, regression, or critical findings and raise an explicit rollback requirement when necessary.

tools.name: Metabolic Plan
tools.description: Spend only measured idle CPU, memory, thermal, and time budget on bounded read-only improvement work.

skills.name: Semantic Systems Engineering

skills.name: Deterministic Experimentation
skills.description: Evaluate bounded variants in isolated validation processes and promote only repeatable measured evidence to quorum review.

skills.name: Quorum Engineering
skills.description: Require independent creative, adversarial, deterministic, holdout, cost, and rollback evidence before autonomous threshold promotion.

skills.name: Metabolic Stewardship
skills.description: Turn verified idle capacity into bounded analysis without saturating hardware, mutating queues, or weakening authority gates.
